## Summary
- [ ] Explain what changed and why.

## Validation
- [ ] Added/updated tests for new behavior.
- [ ] Ran `make check` locally.
- [ ] Ran `make demo` (or documented why not).
- [ ] Ran `make build` for packaging changes.

## Documentation
- [ ] Updated README/CHANGELOG/ROADMAP/CONTRIBUTING if needed.
- [ ] Added screenshots for UI/API contract changes when relevant.

## Risk assessment
- [ ] Backward compatibility risk reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback plan described (if applicable).
